description: You are given a protein receptor structure (receptor.pdb). The binding pocket center is located at coordinates (26.236750, 8.455563, 8.570957) in Angstroms with a pocket radius of 12 Angstroms. Your task is to identify the 3 most conserved pharmacophoric interaction points within this binding pocket. Each point should be specified by its 3D coordinates (x, y, z) and one interaction type. The valid interaction types are: Donor, Acceptor, Aromatic, Hydrophobic, Cation, Anion. Output a CSV file titled 'solution.csv' with columns x,y,z,type containing exactly 3 rows (no header).
